payload.reason: The evidence provides details about human evaluation results for text generation tasks, specifically in the context of summarization models.

claims.text: Human evaluation results for extracted summaries are demonstrated in Appendix A.6, showing the superiority of the proposed system over baselines.
Two samples for human evaluation and case analysis of extractive summaries predicted by the HiStruct+ model are provided, comparing them with gold summaries.
The evaluation results of the HiStruct+ models are summarized, indicating their performance in comparison to baseline models.
